_meta.purpose: Outlet registry — for each news outlet in the feed: its editorial lean (third-party aggregation, mirrored from news-feed.json outlet_lean) plus its OWNER / parent group and a funding_type, each cited. Lets a reader weigh who is telling a story and who funds them. Facts only: ownership + funding structure, not motive.

funding_types.corporate_conglomerate: Owned by a large diversified corporate group (cross-sector interests)
funding_types.corporate_media: Owned by a listed / corporate media house (media-primary)

_meta.note: owner / funding are matters of public record (company filings, investor disclosures, reporting). lean is third-party media-bias aggregation, recorded as aggregation — not the project's own judgement. Where a fact isn't citable it is left an explicit gap, never guessed.
